entities.name: TGFBI / betaig-h3
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed human UniProt Q15582; 683 aa mature precursor sequence analyzed.
Predicted molecular weight is 74.68 kDa; theoretical pI 7.62; instability index 33.25; GRAVY -0.085.
N-terminal signal peptide spans residues 1–23, supporting secretion.
Architecture comprises an N-terminal EMI domain around residues 45–99 and four tandem FAS1/fasciclin domains spanning approximately residues 103–632.
Contains a reported cell-attachment motif at residues 642–644 and cysteine/disulfide features in the N-terminal and internal regions.
Curated localization: secreted extracellular-matrix protein, associated with microfibrils, cell surface, basement membrane, and extracellular exosomes.
Curated function: cell adhesion and collagen interactions; binds type I, II, and IV collagens and can bind integrins.

No explicit catalytic reaction, enzyme cofactor, or enzymatic pathway was retrieved; this supports a structural/adhesive rather than catalytic role, but absence of a reaction is not proof of inactivity.
GO evidence includes extracellular matrix, extracellular region, elastic fiber, collagen binding, cell adhesion molecule binding, integrin binding, and extracellular-matrix structural constituent.
Sequence-based evidence is exceptionally strong because the query exactly matches the reviewed human reference sequence.

entities.name: Human TGFBI Q15582
observations: Reviewed UniProt human reference for transforming growth factor-beta-induced protein ig-h3 (TGFBI; betaig-h3).
Binds type I, II, and IV collagens and participates in cell adhesion and extracellular-matrix interactions.
Contains EMI plus four FAS1 domains and a C-terminal cell-attachment motif.
Secreted and extracellular-matrix localized; may associate with microfibrils and the cell surface.
